hostels.summary: Our flagship backpacker hostel, steps from Bugis Street and the Kampong Glam heritage district.
hostels.name: Beary Best! Hostel — Kampong Glam
writeup: Our TWL Hospitality capsule property sits in the heart of Bugis, a short walk from Kampong Glam, Haji Lane and the Bugis MRT interchange.
Dorms and private rooms are designed for independent / group travellers, with a shared rooftop common area for guests to mingle.

hostels.summary: A conservation shophouse conversion in the heart of Chinatown, close to Maxwell Food Centre.
hostels.name: Beary Best! Hostel — Chinatown
writeup: Housed in a restored conservation shophouse, this hostel blends heritage architecture with modern dorm and ensuite room options.
Guests are a two-minute walk from Maxwell Food Centre and the Chinatown MRT station, with easy access to the CBD.

hostels.summary: A quieter, budget-friendly base near Bendemeer & Boon Keng MRT with easy access to the city and Kallang riverside.
hostels.name: Beary Best! Hostel — Lavender
writeup: Our Lavender property is a favourite with longer-stay guests, offering a calmer neighbourhood setting a few minutes from Boon Keng and Bendemeer MRT.
The Kallang Riverside and city centre are both a short ride away, making it a practical base for both leisure and work travel.

hostels.summary: Our upscale hostel asset, popular with tourist exploring Singapore and visiting for MICE.
hostels.name: Futura Boutique Hostel
writeup: Located within minutes walk to Havelock MRT, this hostel provides easy access to many of Singapore's tourist hotspots.
Within minutes walk to Tiong Bahru Market, one of Singapore's hipster town with pre-war conservation architecture.
